text:
maria: canary failing on payments - 502s and KMS decryption errors after this morning's env rollout. paging oncall :rotating_light:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P0: Canary failures for payments. Paging @oncall-sre. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.local/alert/9876
oncall-sre: I'm on it. grabbing logs.
maria: deployed commit b7f3b4 with env update: switched KMS key to `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/NEWKEY` via release pipeline. Canary started 08:12 UTC then errors at 08:14 UTC.
kevin: seeing logs: `ERROR: aws_kms.Decrypt: AccessDeniedException: not authorized to use key` from service payments-canary pod-3f2a
siva: confirmed IAM/key policy - new KMS key policy only allows ops-admin and key-rotation role, platform/canary-runner not listed. rotation script didn't propagate grants.
devon: can we flip the feature flag to kill canary traffic? `feature_flags.kill_switch.payments_canary = true`
oncall-sre: Doing kill-switch now, switching traffic to stable. running: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/payments_canary/kill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"`
ops-bot: Audit: flag change by oncall-sre at 08:20 UTC. Traffic rerouted, canary error rate -> 0, stable remains healthy.
maria: rolling back env var change in canary to previous KMS key id to restore decrypts: `kubectl set env deploy/payments-canary KMS_KEY_ID=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/OLDKEY -n prod-canary`
kevin: after rollback, decrypt errors stop on canary pods. requests succeed with 200s. metrics: latency normal.
oncall-sre: we need to fix key policy/iam properly. assigning to @siva to add decrypt permission for role `arn:aws:iam::123:role/platform/canary-runner` on NEWKEY.
siva: will create temporary grant and open change request for key policy update. running: `aws kms create-grant --key-id NEWKEY --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/platform/canary-runner --operations Decrypt`
maria: customer impact: ~1% of traffic (canary shard) between 08:14-08:20 saw 502s during checkout. no broader customer outage.
oncall-sre: @ops-bot please open incident ticket and notify support with impact summary. also will start a short incident timeline for follow-up.
ops-bot: Ticket INC-2026-125 created. Notified #support with summary and suggested customer messaging.
devon: after siva confirms grant/policy change, we'll redeploy canary to validate. propose adding a KMS preflight in the pipeline to verify `Decrypt` permission for target role before promoting env.
siva: grant created and change request submitted at 08:42. redeploying canary now.
maria: canary redeployed, new pods show no decrypt errors. request logs return 200, metrics look stable.
oncall-sre: closing incident for now. Postmortem scheduled. Action items: 1) KMS preflight check in release pipeline, 2) update rotation script to add grants/key policy entries, 3) document kill-switch and runbook for deploy-time secret errors. handoff: Siva owns KMS policy change, Maria owns pipeline changes.
siva: acknowledged, will own KMS policy remediation and postmortem writeup.
maria: thanks all :heart:
